title: Fubini and the fundamental lemma: product-tested vanishing forces a.e. vanishing of slice integrals
statement: Let a, b, c, d ∈ ℝ, I := (a, b), J := (c, d), and let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable on I × J. Let g : ℝ → ℝ be continuous with tsupport g ⊆ J. Assume ∫_{ℝ×ℝ} g(α)·l(t)·H(t, α) d(t, α) = 0 for every l ∈ C¹(ℝ) with tsupport l ⊆ I. Then ∫_J g(α)·H(t, α) dα = 0 for almost every t ∈ I.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), IntegrableOn H (Ioo a b ×ˢ Ioo c d) → Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ Ioo c d → (∀ l : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 l → tsupport l ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g p.2 * l p.1 * H p = 0) → ∀ᵐ t, t ∈ Ioo a b → ∫ α in Ioo c d, g α * H (t, α) = 0
